about.upgradeFailed: Upgrade failed; backend verification did not complete. Check the update log.
about.connectionLost: Connection interrupted. Checking backend update status.
about.githubUnavailable: GitHub is unreachable ({{value1}}). You can still copy the host command.
about.verifying: Waiting for backend restart and version verification.
about.kernelHelp: The changelog for this version range mentions wrap-cli/sync. After upgrading the control plane, reinstall the kernel from the kernel page or add --sync-wrap to install.sh.
about.updateScope: Run on the host. Preserves .env, vms, and data. Local slots sync the kernel and CLI; cluster slots rebuild images and replace containers using the same kernel, cli-node, and Go telemetry, preserving credentials and fingerprints.
about.noNewEntries: No entries newer than the current version.
about.confirmDescription: Updates and restarts the control plane. The panel will be briefly unavailable and refresh automatically afterward. Slots, configuration, and data are preserved.
backup.title: Backups
backup.restoreHint: Restoring requires confirm: true. Protocol endpoints return 503 during restoration.
backup.confirmDescription: Restoration overwrites the current state. Protocol endpoints return 503 during restoration. Explicit confirmation is required.
branding.imageHint: PNG, JPEG, or WebP, up to 256 KB. Leave blank to use the default icon.
branding.title: Site branding
branding.description: The brand name, logo, and favicon are applied to the sign-in page and admin console.
branding.name: Brand name
health.description: Probe and test requests are answered before scheduling, without consuming concurrency, session seats, or affinity.
health.warmupHelp: Applies only to Claude models on /v1/messages. Claude Code Warmup, title generation, SUGGESTION MODE, and haiku max_tokens=1 connectivity checks receive simulated responses without calling upstream.
health.minimumTokensHelp: Raises small max_tokens values to the minimum on outbound Claude requests to avoid truncating probes before output. Requests without max_tokens are unaffected.
health.cacheHelp: Periodically runs a real conversation on a slot and caches the result. hi / ping requests such as new-api channel tests and sub2api account tests replay the cache for streaming and non-streaming Messages, Chat, and Responses.
health.disabledHint: When disabled, probes are scheduled normally
health.probeAllHelp: Probe every schedulable slot once per interval, subject to concurrency limits, working hours, cooldowns, and credential exclusions. The first successful result is cached. When disabled, stop at the first available slot.
health.cacheTtlHelp: Seconds; expired probes are scheduled normally
health.claudeModelHelp: Run real probes on Claude slots
health.gptModelHelp: Run real probes on GPT slots. Leave blank to bypass the cache for GPT probe requests.
health.signatureRepairHelp: If upstream returns 400 for a thinking signature, remove thinking history and retry once so the client can receive 200.
health.signatureDisabledHelp: When disabled, thinking / signature blocks for the same account are preserved, missing fields are filled with empty values, and 400 responses pass through unchanged. Account-switch cleanup, cli-node behavior, and other repairs (search, prefill, tool pairing, schema, adaptive) are unaffected.
saveProtocolFailedSlots: Protocol saved, but {{count}} slots did not inherit it: {{value2}}
saveProtocolFollowFailed: Protocol saved, but slots did not inherit global settings: {{value1}}
quotaDescription: Claude quota gates, concurrency, and RPM. GPT quotas are on the OpenAI page. Personal-use onboarding disables gates and raises limits; you can adjust them here.
openaiDescription: GPT transport, access, quotas, and client profile. Global WebSocket settings apply only to inference, not terminals or clusters.
kernelUpdated: Kernel settings updated live on {{count}} slots
savedInherited: Saved · {{count}} slots now inherit global settings · {{value2}}
kernelMissing: Kernel files are missing. Download wrap/crag binaries on the kernel page before syncing.
logs.title: Logs
logs.debugRetentionHelp: request_log_debug rows. Cannot exceed the retention period above.
logs.storageHelp: 0 disables size-based cleanup. Oldest debug rows are deleted when the limit is exceeded.
notify.periodicHelp: Send summaries at the report interval
notify.vmOfflineHelp: Send through enabled notification channels when a node disconnects, a kernel fails, or a running VM stops
notify.enableHelp: Send notifications based on pool status and event rules
notify.checkOnStartHelp: Check the account pool immediately after gateway restart
notify.cooldownHelp: Seconds; minimum interval between events of the same type
notify.minimumAvailableHelp: Trigger a low-pool alert below this count
notify.consoleUrlHelp: Return link in notifications; leave blank to use the backend URL
notify.channelHelp: Included in scheduled notification channels after saving
notify.savedToken: Saved; leaving blank preserves the existing token
notify.tokenHelp: Get it from BotFather. It will not be displayed after saving.
notify.chatHelp: Personal ID or a group ID starting with -100
notify.savedWebhook: Saved; leaving blank preserves the existing URL
notify.webhookHelp: Group settings → Group bot → Copy Webhook URL (or enter only the key). It will not be displayed after saving.
notify.mentionAllHelp: Notify every member of the group
official.title: Official Claude Code initialization
official.description: These settings control initialization outside the slot. When enabled, each token replacement wipes and reruns the official hello flow. Transport is fixed to Rust cli-hop and cannot be changed to HTTP here. The data plane runs the CLI: cli-node + kernel by default, with cc-node + kernel or crag + cc-node available. On success, Sync telemetry controls official identity storage and live updates to worker.json. VM seed switches cannot independently enable DNT to override this configuration.
official.residentHelp: Off by default. When enabled, a single hello does not exit.
official.runtimeHelp: Transport is fixed to cli-hop with inference.engine=rust. Saving never sets official_cc.inference to http. Switch among the three kernel combinations on the kernel page. After hello, CLI /usage runs in the slot with two retries on failure; account tier comes from full official usage. hello is not resident by default.
openai.transportHelp: Inference WebSocket and upstream transport. Disabling either the global or GPT gate forces HTTP and rejects inbound WebSocket connections.
openai.globalWebSocketHelp: Master gate for inbound and upstream inference WebSocket. Disabling it forces HTTP for all inference and rejects inbound WebSocket. Terminal and cluster WebSocket are unaffected.
openai.gptWebSocketHelp: GPT inference WebSocket gate. Disabling it forces GPT to HTTP and rejects inbound WebSocket.
openai.globalDisabledHint: Your selection is preserved. The global gate is off, so GPT uses HTTP even when enabled here.
openai.upstreamTransportHelp: WebSocket is preferred by default; HTTP only always uses HTTP/SSE.
openai.transportPreserved: Saved “{{value1}}”. HTTP is enforced while the global or GPT gate is off; your draft is preserved.
openai.accessHelp: Control who can call GPT and how gpt-* reaches codex-kernel.
openai.routingDisabled: Disabled: gpt-* requests return 4xx without falling back to Claude.
openai.claudeCodeHelp: GPT slots do not use Claude Code.
openai.rejectClaudeCodeModels: Reject Claude Code clients for GPT models
openai.clientProfileHelp: Upstream User-Agent, installation metadata, and environment analytics are independent. The latter two are off by default.
openai.installationMetadataHelp: Off by default. When explicitly enabled, inference requests include the slot’s persistent installation UUID and session client_metadata. The raw vm.device_id fingerprint is never sent; this is not a separate fingerprint upload.
openai.environmentAnalyticsHelp: Off by default. When enabled, each session observed by the kernel sends one official codex_thread_initialized POST to /backend-api/codex/analytics-events/events with the real kernel version, OS and version, architecture, session ID, model, and second-resolution timestamp. It describes the kernel host, not the downstream user’s computer. It contains no turn_id, prompt, files, hostname, or MAC and is independent of installation metadata.
openai.catalogVersionHelp: auto fetches and caches the official @openai/codex version, falling back to 0.160.0 on failure.
openai.userAgentHelp: Defaults to {{value1}}. Empty input restores the default to prevent save failures.
quota.localGateHelp: Local gates only stop normal admission early; they cannot lift upstream hard limits. Missing or expired usage data is shown as unknown.
quota.openaiConcurrencyHelp: In-flight requests per account. For OpenAI, 0 does not mean unlimited.
quota.rpmHelp: Requests started per minute per account; 0 = unlimited.
quota.sessionsHelp: Active conversation windows per account; 0 = unlimited. Reclaimed after 5 idle minutes.
quota.sessionScope: Idle conversation windows are still reclaimed after 5 minutes. Selection strategy and queue limits are not edited here.
quota.gptAccounts: GPT accounts: {{count}}. Gates, concurrency, RPM, and session capacity apply only to OpenAI slots.
quota.queueNotSwitch: Queue when full; do not switch accounts. 0 = unlimited.
quota.sessionIdleHint: Active conversation windows; reclaimed after 5 idle minutes
quota.accountOverridesHelp: View the source and runtime state, then open per-slot VM scheduling. The slot editor is not duplicated here.
quota.draftHelp: Draft changes take effect only after saving globally. Account status always reflects live VM data.
poolLive.title: Live status
poolLive.description: Claude pre-scheduling: one device occupies one seat on one VM. Concurrent requests from that device share the seat; when full, requests queue in arrival order.
poolLive.draftHelp: This is the current runtime state. Settings drafts take effect only after global save.
poolLive.waitingConcurrency: Already seated, waiting only for concurrency: {{value1}}
poolLive.waitingSeat: Devices awaiting a new seat, not yet assigned to a VM
poolLive.pendingLimit: Runtime limit {{value1}} · changes to {{value2}} after saving
poolLive.loadFailed: Failed to load runtime details. Try again later.
pool.balanceHelp: New devices choose the VM with the lowest occupancy ratio, spreading load and slowing quota consumption per VM.
pool.fillHelp: New devices choose the fullest VM with room left, filling a few VMs while keeping the rest idle.
pool.budgetHelp: The first seat requires ≥ {{reserve}}% remaining in 5h/7d; filling {{capacity}} seats requires ≥ {{total}}%. Unknown remaining quota is allowed.
pool.zeroBudget: 0% ignores remaining quota and opens seats whenever capacity is available.
pool.returningDevice: Returning device (already has a home VM)
pool.retryDeadlineHelp: Red line = total retry deadline {{value1}}. No wait can exceed it. Timeout returns 529 <part1>pool_queue_timeout</part1>{{value2}} with retry-after.
pool.circuitExclude: This VM leaves the eligible set
pool.probeRecovery: Recover on success; reopen the circuit on failure
pool.allocationHelp: Seat priority for new Claude devices
pool.capacitySummary: Released after the conversation ends · budget reserve {{value2}}%
pool.saveDraftHelp: After applying to the draft, use Save at the bottom of the page to update the running configuration.
pool.streamIdleHelp: Disconnect when the upstream stream has no events for this long. Large file Write operations may be fully buffered upstream, so short values can disconnect valid requests. If unset, KIN_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT (milliseconds) on the control plane applies. After saving, each slot kernel restarts automatically when idle to apply the value.
pool.bodyLimitHelp: Inbound requests above this size return 413. Unset slot kernels keep a 32 MiB limit. After saving, each kernel restarts automatically when idle. The gateway never accepts requests exceeding KIN_MAX_BODY.
pool.toolStreamingHelp: Enabled by default. Adds eager_input_streaming to custom tools, matching official Claude Code with fine-grained tool streaming. Large Write content streams as it is generated, preventing idle timeouts during relaying. Disabling restores full buffering; a client-provided boolean takes priority.
pool.signatureRepairHelp: Perform one repair retry only for repairable signature errors.
protocol.accessHelp: Control who can call Claude. GPT access is configured on the OpenAI page.
protocol.allowClaudeCode: Allow only Claude Code family requests
protocol.rejectOtherClients: All others receive 403 claude_code_only, without account selection or upstream calls.
protocol.detectProxiedHelp: Requests with rewritten User-Agent but an official billing block in system are treated as official and admitted. If the billing block was removed, official system content and a valid user_id are also required.
protocol.detectDisabled: Off: only direct Claude Code is recognized; relayed traffic is treated as third-party.
protocol.passthroughEnabled: On: direct and relay-detected official clients retain the incoming system prompt instead of applying the current prompt profile.
protocol.passthroughDisabled: Off: official clients also use the protocol’s system profile. Enable to preserve their original content.
protocol.directRequirements: Direct access requires all of the following
protocol.enabledRequirements: When enabled, direct access requires all of the following
protocol.requirementsHelp: OpenAI-format entry points and health probes are rejected. CLI quota probes must remain unchanged. Panel tests and internal probes are unaffected.
protocol.cacheHelp: Set the default cache write lifetime while preserving the existing breakpoint layout.
protocol.cachePriority: Headers, explicit request TTL, and session-locked values take priority. Explicit TTL in system templates stays unchanged.
protocol.cacheSaveHelp: After saving, applies to new sessions and owned default markers. Existing session locks stay unchanged. Official passthrough preserves caller breakpoints and omitted TTL.
protocol.thinkingHelp: When callers enable thinking but request hidden output, return a summary instead. Billing is unchanged.
protocol.summarizeEnabled: On: omitted, updates, and requests without display on models that hide thinking by default are sent as summarized.
protocol.summarizeDisabled: Off: preserve the caller’s display. updates is kept only when declared in outbound beta; otherwise it becomes omitted.
protocol.compactHelp: Follows the request model by default. An explicit value replaces the model window; CLAUDE_CODE_AUTO_COMPACT_WINDOW in the request still takes priority.
protocol.modelWindowHelp: When following the model, Opus / Sonnet / Haiku 5.x use 1M; other models use 200K.
protocol.cchHelp: Outbound billing cch. When enabled, add missing values for both trial and subscription accounts.
protocol.cchEnabled: On: fill outbound cch, including trial accounts. Saving updates kernel.json on each slot live, without restarting CLI.
protocol.cchDisabled: Off: always send cch=00000; (five zeros) without computing a digest.
protocol.nativeStickyHelp: Reclaims idle CLI slots inside the kernel. Separate from stream idle timeout and account binding TTL on the affinity page.
protocol.slotIdleHelp: Measured from the last completed task. Active requests are never reclaimed. Applies immediately after saving without restarting the kernel.
quota.noAccounts: No {{value1}}{{value2}} VMs yet. Global policy can still be saved.
quota.defaultTierHelp: Unknown plan or accounts without credentials
quota.overrunHelp: Seated sessions may exceed the gate by this amount before releasing the VM. From gate minus the critical band, new sessions lose priority and each account runs only one request at a time because readings lag behind in-flight work. 0 switches accounts at the gate.
quota.coldRequestProtection: Protect against large cold requests near the gate
quota.coldRequestHelp: Assess request size within the last few percentage points below the gate. Cache hits and final output cannot be predicted precisely, so this is best-effort protection. It neither guarantees staying below the gate nor truncates context or lowers max_tokens.
quota.criticalBandHelp: This band below the gate plus the overrun allowance forms the critical zone: one request at a time, assessed by cold-cache risk.
quota.coldThresholdHelp: Estimated uncached input tokens at or above this value are large. Cold requests count the full prompt; confirmed warm prefixes count only the last user message, excluding max_tokens. Default 100,000: above a normal turn and below an observed 500,000-token cache write.
quota.weeklySplitHelp: Preserves the current fixed-share behavior; Claude only.
quota.weeklyShareHelp: Reserve a fixed share of 7d remaining quota for Max/Fable.
quota.claudeConcurrencyHelp: In-flight requests per account; every Claude tier retains at least one.
quota.accountCount: Accounts: {{value1}}. GPT quotas are on the OpenAI page.
socks.ipv6SyncFailed: IPv6 settings saved, but {{value1}} egress routes were not synchronized: {{value2}}. Reconnect the nodes and retry.
socks.ipv6Disabled: IPv6 proxy egress disabled; existing connections disconnected
socks.scope: Manage lists, bindings, and imports in Proxy pool. This page configures gateway behavior. Each slot needs an egress route; each route supports up to five slots by default.
socks.ipv6Help: Off by default. Enable to probe, bind, and use SOCKS5 proxies with IPv6 addresses. Disabling disconnects existing connections on those routes but preserves slots, bindings, and probe history. Slot bridges remain IPv4; DNS and routing policies are unchanged.
socks.ipv6Format: Use <part1>[2001:db8::1]:1080</part1> or a full SOCKS5 URL for IPv6. Proxy and slot network status distinguish “IPv6 disabled” from probe failures.
socks.remoteHelp: Each SOCKS5 proxy gets a transparent gateway. egress is the VM’s default route. Slots only run inference: no SOCKS dialing or HTTPS_PROXY inside them.
socks.keepaliveHelp: Residential NAT often drops idle TCP after about 15 minutes. The gateway closes both ends after 7 idle minutes and uses 15-second keepalive.
socks.localHelp: A local proxy is each host’s own public egress. Control-plane slots use the control plane; cluster slots use their node. It is not one fixed VPS. The console labels these as the current VPS local proxy or the node name’s local proxy. Regular users cannot access the proxy pool.
socks.nodeEgressHelp: Node-slot token replacement, refresh, tests, timezone, and geolocation also use that node’s SSH path and egress. Requests fail when the node is disconnected, without falling back to the control plane.
socks.perHostHelp: One local proxy per VPS: px-local on the control plane and one per cluster node, created automatically on connection. Binding limits, connectivity, and geolocation are per host. Slots can bind only their own host’s local proxy, always listed first.
sticky.description: Claude and OpenAI share these settings, while binding records and platform request flows remain separate.
sticky.bindingHelp: Prefer the bound account without changing Claude’s independent seat behavior
sticky.bindingTtlHelp: Binding TTL remembers the VM; it does not occupy a seat.
sticky.platformFlowHelp: The gateway first uses an explicit caller session, then existing identity fallbacks. Claude keeps device/seat affinity. OpenAI keeps account binding and borrows slots when busy; previous_response_id cannot resume across arbitrary accounts. Legacy mode, header_keys, and body_keys remain stored in routing config but have no inactive editors here.
sticky.draftHelp: After applying to the draft, save at the bottom of the page to update the running configuration.
sticky.enableBindingHelp: Prefer the original account for the same source within the TTL.
sticky.outboundHelp: Passthrough requires upstream to accept the caller’s session. Rebuild generates a stable outbound identity at the gateway.
telemetry.seedHelp: Writes the switch to the files above. Toggling a running slot restarts its telemetry sidecar; local slots also restart kin-egress.
telemetry.identityHelp: The sidecar uses only identity from official initialization. Until it exists, worker.json stays disabled and the sidecar remains idle without uploading.
telemetry.uploadHelp: During session activity, send an event_logging/v2/batch every {{value1}}. GrowthBook eval is sent at startup, then every 6 hours.
telemetry.silentHelp: Stop sending 10 minutes after the last activity. Telemetry requests from the CLI itself are answered locally by the gateway without outbound traffic.
telemetry.intervalHelp: Send event batches at this interval during session activity. Applies globally; saving updates each slot’s worker.json live without restarting the sidecar.
telemetry.description: Each Claude slot has one switch stored in seed policy <part1>telemetry_disabled</part1>. All other keys follow it.
telemetry.noSlots: No Claude slots yet. Create a slot and complete official initialization to see its telemetry status here.
telemetry.seedContractHelp: The switch determines every key below. These keys are locked inside the slot and cannot be changed through extra_env on the seed page.
telemetry.syncAfterTokenHelp: After successful official initialization, enable telemetry for the slot using its official identity.
telemetry.gptHelp: The GPT kernel’s own analytics reporting, independent of the Claude sidecar above.
telemetry.confirmEnable: Enable telemetry for all Claude slots?
telemetry.confirmDisable: Disable telemetry for all Claude slots?
telemetry.confirmWrite: Rewrite seed files for {{count}} slots sequentially.
telemetry.confirmIdentity: Slots without official initialization identity are set to on but only upload after the identity is written.
telemetry.clusterIdentityMissing: Seed is on, but this cluster slot has no official initialization identity. worker.json remains disabled; the sidecar stays idle without uploading. Official initialization is not currently supported for cluster slots.
telemetry.identityMissing: Seed is on, but worker.json has no official initialization identity. The sidecar stays idle without uploading and starts automatically after official initialization.
telemetry.processIdle: Enabled, but the sidecar is not running; it is usually restarting.
telemetry.clusterUploadsUnavailable: Cluster-slot upload history is stored on the node and cannot currently be read by the panel.
telemetry.noUploads: No upload history yet. The sidecar starts uploading when sessions become active.
telemetry.disabledNoUploads: Telemetry is off; no upload history.
pool.unreachableSeat: Seats starting at {{seat}} can never be allocated.
telemetry.longInterval: For intervals over 10 minutes, uploads require both the scheduled time and activity within the last 10 minutes.

telemetry.confirmRemote: {{count}} are cluster slots without official initialization support and will not upload even when enabled.

outboundReferenceDescription: Read-only values for the saved global preset. See System prompts for structure rules; the controls above determine cache TTL, CCH and thinking display. This is a Node profile reference; actual transmitted values are available in debug logs when marked cli_final.
sync14008EntrypointHelp: Billing cc_entrypoint and the outbound UA share one value. Caller billing is preserved.
sync14008EntrypointSaveHelp: Saved to each Claude slot's kernel.json; cli-node reads it on the next request.
